{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the result: number of unique patients
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Confirm the data has been deduplicated
df_dedup.head()"}
